cat /srv/lab/iostat.txt
awk '/^Device/ {t=1; next} t && ($6+0 >= 20 || $12+0 >= 20) {print $1}' /srv/lab/iostat.txt > /tmp/slow.txt
cat /tmp/slow.txt   # sda
answers.4:
cat /srv/lab/sar-u.txt
grep -E '^[0-9]{2}:' /srv/lab/sar-u.txt | grep -v CPU | sort -k8 -n | head -1 | awk '{print $1}' > /tmp/peak.txt
cat /tmp/peak.txt   # 10:30:01 (idle 6.4, iowait 38.5)
# iowait 도 같이 높다: 이 시각의 병목은 CPU 가 아니라 디스크일 가능성이 크다
answers.6:
cat /srv/lab/dmesg-oom.txt
grep 'Out of memory: Killed process' /srv/lab/dmesg-oom.txt | awk '{print $12}' | tr -d '()' > /tmp/victim.txt
grep 'Out of memory: Killed process' /srv/lab/dmesg-oom.txt | awk '{print $11}' > /tmp/victim_pid.txt
cat /tmp/victim.txt /tmp/victim_pid.txt   # mysqld, 2210
answers.8:
ps -ef | grep 'sleep 300'
P=$(pgrep -f '^sleep 3000$')
ls -l /proc/$P/fd | grep /srv/lab > /tmp/openfiles.txt
cat /tmp/openfiles.txt   # 7 -> data.csv, 8 -> app.log
